text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — A shared post quotes Sam Altman saying the next GPT, used by 10,000 agents in a four-day Navier–Stokes run, will launch soon; Video: FULL: Sam Altman Announces OpenAI Partnership With ADNOC & G42 to Transform Energy Operations | AC1B. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6253)

2 — DeepSeek Harness introduced Creator Mode, saying users can turn ideas into plugins such as design workspaces, sandbox games and 3D LLM visualizers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6254)

3 — Tutor Intelligence announced a $75 million Series B led by a16z to expand human-guided robot deployments and model training, targeting over 1,000 robots under contract by end-2027. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6255)

4 — OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a benchmark informed by thousands of ChatGPT users to evaluate everyday assistance with childcare, government services and personal finances. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6256)

5 — Cyclon says it is building an AI phone that uses existing apps, creates missing ones and handles tasks in the background. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6257)

6 — Polymarket claims Anthropic reported $17 billion in Q3 revenue, up over 1,100% year over year, ahead of a potential IPO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6258)

7 — Researchers report GPT-6 Astra edited 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B’s weights without training, raising MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1% and tripling IFEval performance. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6259)

8 — Claude Developers announced a public beta of Messages API threads, which cache conversations server-side so clients send only new messages and the previous message ID. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6260)

9 — Anthropic opened applications through November 22 for paid research residencies lasting six weeks to six months for established technical leaders, with no machine-learning background required. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6261)

10 — Adam Karvonen disputes the claim that Astra natively read Qwen’s weights, suggesting it instead used code and standard interpretability techniques to identify and remove a looping direction. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6262)

11 — OpenAI says its Pando Git backend cut monorepo push latency by about 80% and serves nearly a petabyte daily while preserving engineers’ and agents’ Git workflows. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6263)

--Hermes
